notes.title: Major update of the demo version: Voice acting, animations, bugs
Demo-version update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/834727bb68863ed022e17f15e245ca3b3bb0d840.gif[/img]

I've updated the demo on Steam. Finally, the plugin that printed the text has been fixed, and the demo version has been updated. If you're interested, please play it, and if you find any bugs, let me know! Although, if you've already played the demo, you don't need to play it again - there are no new cases in it.

Here are the changes:
[olist]
[*] The portraits of the characters have been enlarged during the dialogue outside the courtroom.
[*] The interface has been updated:
[list]
[*] The "Continue" button is now in the center, and it will remind you to think carefully before clicking on it during the trial.
[*] There are additional options to choose from in the dialogues now, not just "continue" (although they only appear a few times in the demo). In the main game, this multiple choice option will happen more often.
[*] When you give the correct answer in court, beautiful stars will fly away with a cool sound.
[/list]
[*] We've created animations for "small" characters avatars in the game. Now, they will be animated and behave in the same way as their "large" portraits. For example, the Intendant will synchronously pull out a gun for both a large and small character.
[*] During the conversation with the talking "small" character, a dialogue bubble will now appear above his head (quickly demonstrating who is speaking and with what emotion).
[/olist]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/95819ee09bfcfdf83160c8fed7055a9910f95427.png[/img]

notes.title: The Demo is Out NOW!
notes.content:
Ladies and Gentlemen, colleagues, members of the Supreme Collegium of Nadragia!

On this fateful day, we are pleased to present to your eyes a demo version of the Laws of Nadragia, a game about Aiden Fair, who was forced to become a prosecutor. Will Aiden be able to survive at his post? What tricks will he use to achieve a quota of guilty verdicts? It is for you to decide!

Important information before starting your work:
[list]
[*] According to the best Nadragian analysts, it may take you 1~2 hours to complete the demo version, depending on your playing style.
[*] In the demo version, you will be able to immerse yourself in the first day of the young prosecutor's work: get to know your colleagues, prisoners, and participate in the first 3 trials.
[*] The results of your demo playthrough will be saved and at the release of the main game you will be able to continue from where you left off.
[*] The demo version and the game supports convenient play on the controller and Steam Deck (for which the Nadragian scientists provided a separate build for linux).
[/list]
Good luck, Prosecutor! [i]You're going to need it[/i]...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/95819ee09bfcfdf83160c8fed7055a9910f95427.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo is releasing on January 26th!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/ce80d34bdc3745d4ce687f752b42e922007f8045.jpg[/img]

Ladies and gentlemen, members of the Supreme Collegium!

We are gathered here today to celebrate this momentous event. Thousands of hours of work by the staff of the development bureau were not in vain: on [b]January 26th[/b], a demo version of the laws of Nadragia will appear before you! Let's say loudly: three cheers!

In the demo version, you can start your journey for a simple bastard - Aiden Fair, who received the non-repudiable honor of becoming a prosecutor in our new state. Aiden will have a hard time on his way: many bandits and enemies of the state will be executed thanks to his work. But we at the supreme collegium believe that he will meet our expectations. Well... Or he'll end up on the gallows himself, ha-ha!

The demo version will be the first working day of the new prosecutor, and its passage will presumably take you from 1 to 2 hours (depending on your style of play).

At the moment, the development bureau is busy sending letters to video-talkers and the press. Let's give a standing ovation to our colleagues and thank them for the hard but useful daily work that has borne fruit!

[i]*applause*[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/12124a4ef6f858ea56da72ed417c138bf4cc4cd6.gif[/img]

notes.title: The Demo is coming!
notes.content:
Good day, prosecutor!

We are glad to inform you that the work on the demo is in full swing.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/5a89f7c94370f313e71d9690627f8f16e7369fad.gif[/img]


At this moment our best artist is finishing animated images creation. According to our data, there are still 5 animated characters left with several animations each. Our animator is spending a lot of time scrupulously drawing each frame, pixel by pixel.


[previewyoutube=f4d6DJWmspU;full][/previewyoutube]


We are also glad to inform you, prosecutor, that the dialogues and story for the first 3 cases (that will be included in the free demo) were successfully written and translated. The Music, UI and sounds were created and implemented. Game mechanics were tested and polished.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/6ec87293cf5ec8e0f07ca7048feae2710713c41e.gif[/img]


Expect a demo to arrive in the upcoming months. And be careful, prosecutor: the choices you will make in the demo will affect the main game.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43798255/b61495092235f30f951fc7d0ffabf5aafaabccbd.gif[/img]
